scientific_integrity: The result claims a proof of published computational predictions, not first discovery of their numerical values. Computer-generated finite certificates are combined with explicit mathematical all-length lifting and template completeness arguments.
scientific_limitations: Only the four iterates k=2,3,4,5 are settled; numerical values were previously suggested without proof, and no general formula for k>=6 is claimed. The finite checks are exhaustive only because a two-adic factor-cover lemma proves completeness. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Rigorous higher-tortoise stabilization thresholds for the regular paperfolding word
